properties.name: app.http-clients.base-urls.products
properties.description: Base URL of the Products microservice, used by ProductServiceClient for HTTP Interface consumption. Overridden at runtime by the PRODUCTS_BASE_URL environment variable.

properties.name: app.http-clients.base-urls.clients
properties.description: Base URL of the Clients microservice, used by ClientServiceClient for HTTP Interface consumption. Overridden at runtime by the CLIENTS_BASE_URL environment variable.

properties.name: app.http-clients.connect-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to downstream services (products, clients).

properties.name: app.http-clients.read-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for waiting for a response from downstream services (products, clients).

properties.name: app.payment.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of payment attempts per order, including the initial charge and manual retries. Orders exceeding the limit are cancelled.

properties.name: app.payment.callback-api-key
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate PSP payment callbacks via the apiKey header. Overridden at runtime by the PSP_CALLBACK_API_KEY environment variable.

properties.name: app.kafka.server-url
properties.description: Kafka bootstrap servers in host:port format (comma-separated for a cluster). Overridden at runtime by the KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS environment variable.

properties.name: app.kafka.acks
properties.description: Number of acknowledgements the producer requires from brokers before considering a request complete.

properties.name: app.kafka.retries
properties.description: Number of times the producer retries sending a record when it fails.

properties.name: app.kafka.max-block-ms
properties.description: Maximum time the producer blocks while waiting for metadata or buffer space before failing.
